name: solar-system-united-nations
title: United Nations of Sol
author: 虚无群友
description:
五个阵营在不断跃迁的公共星球上发展。生产科技瓶、积累个人经验、建造限时房产，把产业延续到下一颗新星球。

快速入门：
· 从难民营门口前往本国公共星球。
· 亲手合成木箱会得到个人关联箱；放置后可用机械臂投入科技瓶。
· 在“建造”页建造房产，或领取低保金币购买本国房产。
· 跃迁前把重要设备和物资搬入难民营或房产。
· 在本国市场交易，与本国玩家共同影响货物价格。

支持简体中文、繁體中文、English 及多种主要语言。
QQ 群：293280221
GitHub：https://github.com/sandboxtech/solar-system-united-nations

United Nations of Sol is a Space Age multiplayer scenario where five factions develop public planets that periodically shift into new worlds. Turn science packs into experience, establish temporary property, trade in independent national markets, and carry your industry forward through diplomacy and conflict. Available in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and other major languages.
